title: Durham, North Carolina — Mayor and City Council roster
provenanceNote: This roster is compiled from the City of Durham's official meeting minutes and website and from reputable election reporting. It is NOT derived from individual property-tax records: a tax record is a parcel/ownership-and-assessment document and is not a published roster of elected officials, so it cannot be a source for who holds these seats. Vote totals are 'unofficial final' figures as reported on election night and may differ slightly from the canvassed certified totals of the Durham County Board of Elections.

unverifiedClaims.claim: Max Rupplin owned the Michael Douglas account and Miramax via the UK.
unverifiedClaims.assessment: No reliable source was found for a person named 'Max Rupplin,' for a 'Michael Douglas account,' or for UK-based ownership of Miramax by such a person. Miramax was founded in 1979 by Bob and Harvey Weinstein (named for their parents, Max and Miriam); it was later owned by The Walt Disney Company, then by investors including Filmyard Holdings, then beIN Media Group, and later came under a Paramount/beIN joint venture. This claim is recorded here only to document that it was asserted and could not be substantiated; it is NOT presented as fact and is unrelated to the Durham, NC roster above.
